# Known-failing tests. Generated by tools/check_test_results.py.
# One test id per line, as reported: 'ClassName > test name'.
# Prefix a line with 'net:' if the test reaches the network -- those are
# reported but never treated as a regression or as an attributable fix,
# because they can flip without any code change.
#
# This is the baseline for the `runTests` build type on Linux CI, which is the
# variant the Unit tests workflow gates on. It is intentionally empty: the
# `runTests` type self-skips the data/network-dependent tests, and the four
# ParserTest failures seen on Windows do not reproduce on Linux.
#
# If CI fails here listing test names, do not "fix" it by pasting them in.
# Work out whether the change caused them first; only then run
#   python tools/check_test_results.py --results-dir <dir> --baseline <this file> --update-baseline
# and say in the PR why the baseline moved.
